init.title: Nefit Easy settings
init.description: Home Assistant reloads the integration after saving.

data_description.min_temp: Lowest target temperature you can set from Home Assistant.
data_description.max_temp: Highest target temperature you can set from Home Assistant.
data_description.temp_step: Step size of the target temperature.
data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks the thermostat for its status, 15 to 3600 seconds. Each poll is about 15 requests to the Bosch cloud, so a short interval means many more requests. The status is never faster than the Bosch cloud answers.
data_description.request_timeout: How long to wait for the answer to one request before trying again or reconnecting, 5 to 60 seconds. The Bosch cloud often needs 10 to 20 seconds; a shorter timeout causes more reconnects.

error.max_below_min: The maximum temperature must be higher than the minimum temperature.
